attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Louisiana corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (post-Wayfair).

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus threshold ($100K gross receipts, no transaction count as of 2023); result.la_gross_receipts is greater than or equal to result.la_economic_nexus_threshold

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Louisiana state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. LA 2025 tax reform introduced $20,000 standard deduction and eliminated federal income tax deduction.

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Louisiana state additions and subtractions; Calculate state-specific income adjustments
action_details.action_dsl: set result.la_state_additions = 0.0; if result.la_us_interest_income != 0.0 then set result.la_state_additions = result.la_state_additions + result.la_us_interest_income; endif set result.la_state_subtractions = 0.0; set result.la_state_subtractions = result.la_standard_deduction; if result.la_municipal_interest != 0.0 then set result.la_state_subtractions = result.la_state_subtractions + result.la_municipal_interest; endif add (("Louisiana additions: $" + string value of (result.la_state_additions)) + ", subtractions: $") + string value of (result.la_state_subtractions) to job.audit_trail; add ("Louisiana standard deduction: $" + string value of (result.la_standard_deduction)) + " (new for 2025)" to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /result.la_state_additions xdef { result.la_state_additions result.la_us_interest_income f+ cvd /result.la_state_additions xdef } {} result.la_us_interest_income 0.0 f== not ifelse 0.0 cvd /result.la_state_subtractions xdef result.la_standard_deduction cvd /result.la_state_subtractions xdef { result.la_state_subtractions result.la_municipal_interest f+ cvd /result.la_state_subtractions xdef } {} result.la_municipal_interest 0.0 f== not ifelse "Louisiana additions: $" result.la_state_additions cvs strconcat ", subtractions: $" strconcat result.la_state_subtractions cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Louisiana standard deduction: $" result.la_standard_deduction cvs strconcat " (new for 2025)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Louisiana corporate income tax. Applies Louisiana flat rate (5.5%) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income. 2025 tax reform replaced graduated rates up to 7.5% with flat 5.5% rate and introduced $20,000 standard deduction.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive taxable income; result.la_apportioned_income is greater than 0

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Louisiana corporate tax (flat rate 5.5% - NEW for 2025); Apply Louisiana 5.5% flat rate
action_details.action_dsl: set result.la_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.la_apportioned_income + result.la_state_additions - result.la_state_subtractions) and (0.0); set result.la_tax_liability = the maximum of (result.la_taxable_income * result.la_corp_tax_rate - result.la_state_credits) and (0.0); set result.la_refund_or_owed = result.la_estimated_payments - result.la_tax_liability; add "Louisiana taxable income: $" + string value of (result.la_taxable_income) to job.audit_trail; add "Louisiana tax liability (5.5% flat rate, effective 2025): $" + string value of (result.la_tax_liability) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: result.la_apportioned_income result.la_state_additions f+ result.la_state_subtractions f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.la_taxable_income xdef result.la_taxable_income result.la_corp_tax_rate fmul result.la_state_credits f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.la_tax_liability xdef result.la_estimated_payments result.la_tax_liability f- cvd /result.la_refund_or_owed xdef "Louisiana taxable income: $" result.la_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Louisiana tax liability (5.5% flat rate, effective 2025): $" result.la_tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No taxable income - no tax liability
